$schema: Machine-readable mirror of src/app/globals.css. Source of truth is the code — regenerate this file by hand whenever globals.css changes, in the same commit. See design-concpet/brand-guidelines.md for the human-readable version with rationale.

brand.name: R²χTECH
brand.tagline: We automate AEC. You ship faster.
brand.descriptor: Computational automation studio for architecture, engineering and construction.

warm._note: Redefines carbon/graphite/line/fg only. Accent tokens inherit from dark scope unchanged.

pale._note: Redefines carbon/graphite/line/fg AND the three accent-ink-role tokens (accentInk, focus, edge). --color-accent itself is never redefined — it stays #e8a94a everywhere, used only as a filled plate on this ground.

labOnly._note: Used only inside the Home hero geodesic overlay, never elsewhere.

rules: Amber text/border/hairline anywhere => use the accentInk token, never the literal accent hex.
Amber as a filled button/plate => use accent + onAccent, on any ground.
Amber is structurally illegible as ink on the pale ground (1.00:1) — this cannot be fixed by choosing a darker amber; see brand-guidelines.md §2.4.
Meaningful borders (fields, controls) => edge token, not line (line is 1.37:1, decorative only).
A component must carry data-site-pale if it visually sits on the pale ground, even if it renders outside the page's own [data-site-pale] wrapper div.
When toggling data-site-pale from a boolean prop, guard with `value || undefined` — a literal `data-site-pale="false"` still matches the CSS attribute selector.

sans.usage: Body and UI text (also the document default)

lead._note: Defined, not yet used anywhere in the codebase.

exceptions: HeroOverlay.tsx headline + scroll statements: bespoke clamp() values tuned against the geodesic model's measured mobile clearance. Do not migrate onto the shared scale.
Panels.tsx AboutPanel lead paragraph: bespoke clamp(1.25rem,2.2vw,2rem) at leading-1.45 — justified running prose, not a heading.

breakpoints._note: Tailwind's default md and 2xl are cleared (--breakpoint-*: initial) and do not exist.

logo.technique: CSS mask-image, recoloured per scope via background-color — never rendered as a plain .
lockups: R² favicon glyph, auto-cropped by scripts/favicon.mjs
logo.clearSpaceDefault: ~1 cap-height (not yet formally specified in code)
